iti15:2.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekasaṃyojanam-pi samanupassāmi yeneva saṃyojanena saṃyuttā sattā dīgharattaṃ sandhāvanti saṃsaranti yathayidaṃ bhikkhave taṇhā saṃyojanaṃ.
iti15:2.2: taṇhāsaṃyojanena hi bhikkhave saṃyuttā sattā dīgharattaṃ sandhāvanti saṃsarantīti.
